result.reason: The operative language gives Company a 30-day convenience-termination right for the Agreement or any SOW and requires repayment of prepaid fees allocable to unperformed Services. Contractor’s existing convenience right applies only when no uncompleted SOW is outstanding, so it cannot terminate an in-flight committed engagement. The amendment is limited and preserves the breach-termination, accrued-payment, and work-in-progress provisions. Drafting is professional, though the overlapping 15-day Company right when no SOW is outstanding creates minor redundancy, and an express reference to a “pro rata” refund would be slightly clearer.
